name: kb_827_Normalized

schema.description: ResourceFieldSelector represents container resources (cpu, memory) and their output format

containerName.description: Container name: required for volumes, optional for env vars

divisor.description: Specifies the output format of the exposed resources, defaults to "1"

description: The configuration targets the **my-app** container, selecting its **cpu** resource for exposure. The selector uses a divisor of **1**, which means the metric will be reported in the default units without any scaling. This setup ensures that the CPU usage of the my‑app container is captured exactly as provided by the system.
